# Vendored front-end files

Served from `/static/vendor/` so the page works when public CDNs are slow or blocked.

| File | Project | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `d3.min.js` | d3 7.9.0 | ISC |
| `topojson-client.min.js` | topojson-client 3.1.0 | ISC |
| `globe.gl.min.js` | globe.gl 2.46.2 (bundles three.js, MIT) | MIT |
| `leaflet.js`, `leaflet.css` | Leaflet 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause |
| `countries-110m.json` | world-atlas 2.0.2 (Natural Earth data) | ISC; data public domain |
| `img/earth-blue-marble.jpg`, `img/earth-topology.png`, `img/night-sky.png` | three-globe example images (NASA Blue Marble and topography) | public domain (NASA) |
| `fonts/Fraunces.woff2`, `fonts/Inter.woff2` | Fraunces and Inter, latin subset from Google Fonts | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
